SCREEN — 时间与地图, book 三国演义. Fill the window with a beautiful subtle offline-style geographic base map of the Yangtze/Jingzhou/Chibi area, pale stone land, desaturated blue water, elegant thin roads and gentle terrain contours. Sparse geographic place labels like 江陵、华容、赤壁、夏口, not modern transport clutter. Connected cobalt event pins indicating a historical reading route. Selected pin 赤壁 with a tiny nearby title 赤壁之战, and two understated linked entity chips 周瑜、诸葛亮; do not turn people into a permanent sidebar. Top title island 三国演义 · 时间与地图, top-right primary 回到原文.
At lower-left float ONE compact glass timeline window approximately540×250px with grip/title 时间与地图 and collapse/close. The top row shows one range 208年 — 209年; below exactly ONE horizontal time rail with TWO clearly distinct circular handles on that same rail and faint year tick labels. Do not draw two stacked sliders or duplicate date filters. Selected event details expand BELOW the rail WITHIN THIS SAME floating window:208年 · 赤壁, title 赤壁之战, one-line description 孙刘联军在此迎战曹操, source 第四十九回 and a small 回到原句 action. Most map remains open. A tiny fit/zoom control island floats lower-right, not a second large tool panel. Companion node list is closed. Exact sense: spacious map with a single movable time-and-event instrument at the bottom, large calm controls. No modern map search dashboard, no extra permanent sidebar.

Under a thin separator '输出设置'; a single output token field with value 32768 and a compact adjacent Max action, plus quiet explanatory line Max采用该配置已知的输出上限.
